title: Iris Ohyama cloud data breach exposes 7.7 million records
excerpt: Japanese manufacturer Iris Ohyama reports a security breach involving a third-party cloud service, potentially exposing 7.7 million customer records.
body_html:
Japanese manufacturer Iris Ohyama has disclosed a data security incident affecting its Iris Plaza shopping platform. According to the company, unauthorized access to a third-party cloud service used by the business may have exposed personal information belonging to approximately 7.7 million people.

Details of the Exposure

The incident centers around a cloud environment managed by an external service provider. While investigations are underway, the potential exposure affects a massive volume of customer records tied to the company's online shopping operations in Japan.

Iris Ohyama has not yet detailed the specific types of personal data compromised in the unauthorized access event, but the scale of the exposure impacts millions of platform users.
